Refund & Cancellation Policy

Last updated: 2 November 2026

Wallet top-ups

Money added to your in-app wallet is meant to be spent within VoterSlip Generator. It cannot be transferred to another account or redeemed for cash. If you have a balance you no longer need, you can ask us to return it — see below.

Top-ups made in the Android app

Top-ups made through Google Play in the Android app are refunded through Google Play, under Google's refund process, not to a UPI or bank account by us. The rest of this policy applies to them in every other respect.

Returning unused wallet balance

You can ask us to return money sitting unused in your wallet. Email support.aigentools@gmail.com from the email address your account is registered with, telling us how much you would like returned. We may ask for your registered mobile number to confirm it is you.

Money is returned only to the payment method it came from — the same UPI app, card or bank account you used to top up. We cannot send it to a different account, to someone else, or as cash. This is how a refund works at our payment provider, and it also protects you: nobody who gets into your account can move your balance anywhere but back to you.

What you should know before asking:

  • Only unused balance can be returned. Money already spent on jobs that completed is not returnable.
  • The smallest amount we can return is ₹10.
  • A top-up can only be sent back to its source for a limited period after it was paid — about six months, set by our payment provider, not by us. Balance funded by older top-ups cannot be returned this way, so please do not leave a balance sitting indefinitely if you know you will not use it.
  • We will process a valid request within 3 working days. The money then usually reaches you in 5–7 working days, and in some cases up to two weeks — once we have issued the refund, how quickly it arrives is in the hands of the payment provider and your bank.
  • Your wallet balance goes down by the amount returned. You will see it in your in-app transaction history as "Returned to your payment method".
  • We may hold or decline a request while there is an unresolved payment dispute, chargeback, or suspected fraud on the account.

If you are closing your account, ask us in the same way and we will return whatever unused balance we can, on the same terms.

When you are charged

Before any charge, the App shows a preview with the exact number of rows or slips a job will produce and what it will cost. You are charged when you confirm the job, from your wallet balance.

Jobs that fail after you were charged

If a job you were charged for fails to deliver its file, the App tries to return the full charge to your wallet automatically. If it cannot, it shows a reference for the job. Email that reference to support.aigentools@gmail.com and we will return the full charge to your wallet within 3 working days.

Accidental or incorrect top-up

If you believe you were charged the wrong amount, or a top-up payment succeeded on your bank/UPI app but didn't reflect in your wallet balance within a reasonable time, contact us within 7 days at support.aigentools@gmail.com with your payment reference, and we'll investigate and correct it.

Cancellations

You can leave a job at the preview without paying anything. Once you confirm and the run starts, the charge stands: a run you stop yourself is not refunded.

Slips you decide not to use

A job that completed successfully is not refunded because you later decide not to print or distribute the slips, or because their use turns out not to be allowed for your election — for example, banner slips in an election where only plain slips are permitted, or slips that could only have been distributed during the silence period. Checking the rules before you generate is your responsibility; see the Terms & Conditions. We recommend plain slips, which are also the lower-priced option.

Contact

For any billing question, email support.aigentools@gmail.com.
